<script>
window.__clicks = [];
document.getElementById('open-ticket').onclick = () => { document.getElementById('ticket').style.display = 'block'; };
document.getElementById('x').onclick = () => { document.getElementById('ticket').style.display = 'none'; };
for (const id of ['b','s','m','l','submit']) document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('click', () => window.__clicks.push(id));
// The chosen side / order type reads back as aria-pressed (set
// window.__noPress = true to model a ticket whose selection is unreadable).
const pairs = {b: 's', s: 'b', m: 'l', l: 'm'};
for (const id of Object.keys(pairs)) document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (window.__noPress) return;
  document.getElementById(id).setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
  document.getElementById(pairs[id]).setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
});
document.querySelector('#ord button').addEventListener('click', () => window.__clicks.push('cancel'));
</script>
